hooks.name: Audit UI: Test & Typecheck on Save
hooks.description: When a .ts file under audit-ui/ is saved, runs npm test and tsc --noEmit from audit-ui/. Reports failures in chat.

action.command: cd d:\kiroween-trifecta\kiroween-trifecta\audit-ui && echo '--- Typecheck ---' && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; TSC_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE; echo '--- Tests ---' && npm test -- --run 2>&1; TEST_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE; if ($TSC_EXIT -ne 0 -or $TEST_EXIT -ne 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }
